submission.natural_language_explanation: Strongest (0.6-1.0 of max) on a quantifier word, above all ' All'/' all'/' ALL' (weaker for ' No', ' Some', ' Every'), that comes after an earlier ' Copyright', ' copyright' or ' ©' token that is not the text's first token, as in 'Copyright 2013 Google Inc. All rights reserved', because there the head moves its attention off the first-token sink onto that Copyright/© token; the same ' All' after 'Author', 'Patent', 'Trademark' or '(c)' with no Copyright/© stays weak (about 0.25). Elsewhere the head is a weak dial: moderate (0.3-0.5) on closing brackets that end nested or argument-filled calls (' ),', '))', '")') and on tokens late in an address such as ' MA' or ' Germany', where attention spreads from the first token over earlier content, and low (under 0.2) on openers and on tokens near the start of a text, which attend almost only to the first token.
